title: proto.arturia.minilab
description: `proto.arturia.minilab` provides simple SysEx control for the Arturia MiniLab, accepting commands to set its MIDI channel, control pad backlighting and colors, and set or request knob values. It exchanges raw MIDI bytes with `midiin` and `midiout` and outputs parsed MIDI commands such as note-on, note-off, control-change, and program-change messages; knob indices range from 0 to 17.
